'''FC Etropole''' ({{langx|bg|ФК Етрополе}}) is a Bulgarian [[football club]] based in [[Etropole]], Sofia Province. Founded in 1922, they competes in the [[Third Amateur Football League (Bulgaria)|Third League]], the third level of [[Bulgarian football league system]]. They play their home games at the Chavdar Stadium, which now boasts a capacity of 5,600. Their home colours are red and white.

Chavdar have spent the majority of their playing history between the third and fourth tiers of the Bulgarian football league system. They achieved promotion to the [[Second Professional Football League (Bulgaria)|second tier]] in 2007 following a win against [[POFC Botev Vratsa|Botev Vratsa]] in the play-off.<ref>{{cite web | title = Чавдар (Етрополе) влезе в "Б" група за сефте | url = https://topsport.bg/b-group/chavdar-etropole-vleze-v-b-grupa-za-sefte.html | website = topsport.bg | date = 4 July 2007 | language = Bulgarian}}</ref> The following season, they achieved their highest league finish in club history, ending the season 3rd in the Bulgarian Second Division.<ref>{{cite web | title = Завърши футболното първенство в Западна "Б" група | url = https://botevgrad.com/news/5472/Zavarshi-futbolnoto-parvenstvo-v-Zapadna-B-grupa/ | website = botevgrad.com | date = 18 May 2008 | language = Bulgarian}}</ref>

In [[2009–10 Bulgarian Cup|2009–10 season]], as a second league team, Chavdar contested the [[Bulgarian Cup]] Semi-final for the only time in their history, losing 1–0 against [[PFC Beroe Stara Zagora|Beroe]].<ref>{{cite web | title = Берое на финал | url = https://www.sportal.bg/news.php?news=234689 | website = sportal.bg | date = 28 April 2010 | language = Bulgarian}}</ref>"}}
